jobs.title: Legal Counsel (m/w/d) Voll- oder Teilzeit
jobs.description: Deine Mission feld energy ist mehr als nur ein Unternehmen – wir sind eine Bewegung! Wir helfen Landwirten und Landeigentümer:innen, Landwirtschaft und Energieerzeugung intelligent zu verbinden. Mit unseren innovativen Agri-Photovoltaik-Lösungen nutzen wir Flächen doppelt – für Lebensmittel und saubere Energie. So schaffen wir gemeinsam eine nachhaltigere und wirtschaftlichere Landwirtschaft. Über uns Als Legal Counsel (m/w/d) im Energierecht begleitest du unsere Projekte rechtlich von Anfang bis Ende – von der Vertragsgestaltung mit Partnern bis zu Verhandlungen mit Banken. Mit deinem Fachwissen stellst du sicher, dass wir unsere Vorhaben rechtssicher und zukunftsfähig umsetzen. Deine Aufgaben Bei internen Rechtsfragen bist du erste:r Ansprechpartner:in – lösungsorientiert und pragmatisch Du steuerst externe Kanzleien bei Spezialthemen und stellst sicher, dass juristische Expertise dort eingesetzt wird, wo sie den größten Mehrwert bietet. Du gestaltest, prüfst und verhandelst Verträge insbesondere insbesondere im Bereich Grundstücksnutzung, Projektentwicklung, Beschaffung, Stromvermarktung und Finanzierung. Du kümmerst Dich federführend um das gesamte komplexe Vertragswerk der Gesellschaften und behältst dabei stets das große Ganze im Blick. Mit deinem Blick für Legal Compliance schaffst in einem innovativen Umfeld du Strukturen, die Wachstum ermöglichen und rechtliche Sicherheit geben. Dein Profil Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes erstes und zweites juristisches Staatsexamen mit einer Gesamtpunktzahl von mindestens 16 Punkten (entsprechenden Nachweis bitte einreichen). Erste Berufserfahrung als Rechtsanwalt / Legal Counsel (m/w/d) von Vorteil, idealerweise im Vertragsrecht, Energierecht oder Projektgeschäft. Sicher im Vertragsrecht und in Verhandlung Strukturierte, proaktive Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Dinge aufzubauen und zu verbessern. Offenheit, dich schnell in neue Rechtsgebiete einzuarbeiten. Begeisterung für Nachhaltigkeit, Innovation und die Energiewende Fließ

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Manager, Derivatives Trade Reporting
jobs.description: Who We Are At OKX , we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About the Opportunity OKX is hiring a Senior Compliance Officer to build and run our global derivatives trade and transaction reporting function. The function covers CFTC swap data reporting under Part 45, EU transaction reporting under MiFIR, EU derivatives reporting under EMIR, UK MiFIR and UK EMIR, and ASIC derivative transaction reporting across multiple OKX entities and a growing derivatives product set. These regimes have different scopes, reporting parties, data requirements and destinations. You will determine how they apply to OKX’s activities and help build a reliable process for meeting each obligation. Most of the work is data and judgment: deciding what is reportable, by which entity, and to whom, then making sure the right trade and lifecycle data reaches the right swap data repository, trade repository, or regulator on time and reconciles to our trading records. You will own reporting scoping/eligibility, submission monitoring, and the controls that show our reports are complete, accurate, and timely. This is a hands-on Compliance leadership role. jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
jobs.description: Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix. At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires. I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves. Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week. That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works. You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win. — Grigory Why Secfix exists Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. jobs.description: About Us 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries. Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity. About the Team The Compliance & Recording team owns 1GLOBAL's products for regulated enterprises. We capture mobile voice, SMS and data at network level, with no app on the device, and deliver it to wherever our customers need it: their own on-site recorders and archives, or our Cloud Compliance service built on Verint Financial Compliance. On top of the recordings we offer Communications Analytics, which brings AI transcription, summaries and risk insights to compliance teams. Our customers include 8 of the world's 10 largest banks. They rely on us for a complete, auditable record of every regulated call and message, so reliability and precision are at the heart of everything the team builds. We work closely with engineering, network, security, service delivery and commercial teams.
